articles.summary: From NXT to XStar, MasterCraft’s 2027 Lineup Builds on Proven Performance With Thoughtful Updates Across Technology, Comfort, Functionality and Design 2027 Lineup Introduces Towboat Segment’s First AutoLaunch Technology, an All-New Built-In Inflator, Enhanced SoundStage Audio, Smarter Helm Technology and More MasterCraft Boat Company , a subsidiary of MasterCraft Boat Holdings, Inc (NASDAQ: MCFT) and the best-selling towboat brand, today announced its 2027 model year lineup, introducing thoughtful enhancements inspired by boaters and designed to optimize time on the water. From smarter technology and enhanced audio to greater convenience and expanded personalization, MasterCraft’s 2027 lineup refines the details that make every day behind the boat more seamless and enjoyable. This press release features multimedia.
